rationale: After reaching a session low of $37.25 (1.82% MFE), AMKR has mounted a sharp recovery, reclaiming its 5-minute 9-EMA ($37.74) and erasing nearly all unrealized gains as it presses directly into session VWAP ($38.00). With downside momentum broken and the broader market strong (SPY +0.75%), closing the short position at breakeven is warranted rather than risking an imminent stop-out at $38.12. Flipping to long is avoided because the current ask ($38.00) sits directly at VWAP resistance with a wide 21.1 bps spread.
